**1) JS syntax/runtime blocker:** None found. All new object-bus variables (`objCenterLHP/LLP/RHP/RLP/LGain/RGain/Bus/OutL/OutR`, `objPresenceLHP…RGain`, `objHighLHP…RB`) are declared, created in `buildGraph()`, and consumed in `applyMatrix()` with matching names. **2) Duplicate audible audio:** No literal double-connect of the same signal to the same destination. `analysisNode→analysisSink→ctx.destination` is muted (`analysisSink.gain=0`) and the worklet itself zeroes its output buffer, so the analysis tap is inaudible. All new object buses (`objCenterOutL/R`, `objPresenceLGain/RGain`, `objHighLA/LB/RA/RB`) are additive contributions into `matrixMerge`/`matrixLBus`/`matrixRBus`, not duplicated identical paths — layering by design, not a duplication bug.

**3) OFF state silence/restoration:** Correct. In `applyMatrix()`, `active=enabled&&adaptiveEnabled&&steer.ready`; when `adaptiveEnabled=false`, `active=false`, so `centerExtra`, `highFeed`, `frontL`, `frontR` all stay at their initialized `0`, driving `objCenterOutL/R.gain`, `objPresenceLGain/RGain.gain`, and `objHighLA/LB/RA/RB.gain` to 0 (silent). Simultaneously `rear=b.rear` and `center=b.center` revert to their un-scaled (non-`*.35`/`*.60`) legacy values, and `matrixLGainA/B`, `matrixRGainA/B`, `matrixLL/LR/RL/RR`, `matrixDirectL/R`, `matrixTrim` are computed the same way as before the feature existed. Readouts correctly show `0%`/`OFF`.

**4) Rear coefficient/polarity orientation:** Preserved. `matrixLL=-.49*rear`, `matrixLR=.871*rear`, `matrixRL=-.871*rear`, `matrixRR=.49*rear` are unchanged sign/magnitude pattern (unit-norm quadrature pair) regardless of mode — only the scalar `rear` (via `active?b.rear*.35:b.rear`) changes. The new `objHigh` cross-feed mirrors the existing `matrixLGainA/B` convention (own-channel positive, cross-channel negative via `-objCross*highFeed`), so no polarity flip was introduced.

**5) Gain/classification bug risk — dangerously hot, not ineffective:** `highFeed=clamp(.08+4.70*steer.objRear,.05,4.80)` in `applyMatrix()` is badly out of scale compared to sibling object gains (`centerExtra` capped ≈`.504`, `frontL/R` capped `.28`). At full ambience confidence (`steer.objRear→1`) this injects up to ~4.8× gain into `matrixLBus`/`matrixRBus` for the 3.5–8kHz band, on top of the existing `matrixLGainA/B` unity/cross feed, before the final `rear` scalar and `matrixLimiter` catch it. Combined with the fast `.020s` attack smoothing of `steer.objRear` (in `handleAnalysis()`), this can produce abrupt, large surges on any decorrelated high-frequency transient (cymbals/reverb tails), likely forcing `matrixLimiter` into constant hard-limiting — audibly "hot"/pumping rather than a clean surround lift, and could mask the intended effect (perceived as harsh/ineffective spatial detail). Suggested check: rescale `highFeed` to roughly `clamp(.08+0.5*steer.objRear,.05,.9)` to match the ~2× headroom used by `centerExtra`/`front`, then re-verify against `matrixLimiter` gain-reduction telemetry.
